plans.idea: Classic split: a large bottle on the left half, and on the right one left-aligned column that reads logo, badge pair, headline/subhead, then a modest CTA button, all sharing one left edge.

Three-column left-to-right story: the headline and copy on the left, the bottle centred under a centred logo, and the action column (badges above the CTA) on the right, so the eye goes message, then product, then buy.

Text-led layout: the logo, headline block and CTA sit stacked on the left on one edge, and the bottle sits on the right with the NEW / LIMITED RUN badges as a tag row just above it, grouped with the product.
